title: IBM watsonx.data 2.4.0 through 2.4.0 patch 8 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to conduct a server-side…
description: IBM watsonx.data versions 2.4.0 through 2.4.0 patch 8 contain a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow a remote authenticated attacker to induce the server to make unauthorized requests. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 4.3, indicating medium severity, and impacts the integrity of the system without affecting confidentiality or availability.
